const urls = [
 "http://news.cnr.cn/native/gd/20260727/t20260727_527731759.shtml",
 "https://lexotech.com/News/news-content?did=5c75814a4578fa2c7c5476d5909ae838",
 "https://www.cssn.cn/skgz/bwyc/202604/t20260420_5980978.shtml",
 "https://legal.gmw.cn/2025-03/27/content_37930371.htm",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const iconv=require('iconv-lite');",
 "let i=0;",
 "function next(){",
 " if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
 " const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " const chunks=[];",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 Chrome/131 Mobile'}},function(res){",
 " res.on('data',function(d){chunks.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){",
 " let buf=Buffer.concat(chunks);",
 " let head=buf.slice(0,3000).toString('latin1');",
 " let m=/charset=[\\\"']?([\\w-]+)/i.exec(head);",
 " let enc=m?m[1].toLowerCase():'utf-8';",
 " let s;",
 " try{ s = (enc.indexOf('gb')===0)?iconv.decode(buf,'gbk'):buf.toString('utf8'); }catch(e){ s=buf.toString('utf8'); }",
 " s=s.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
 " s=s.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34));",
 " s=s.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
 " console.log('===== '+u+' OK '+res.statusCode+' enc='+enc+' len='+s.length);",
 " console.log(s.substring(0,4000));",
 " next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message);next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-st2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-st2.cjs";

console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 14000));

  "https://legal.gmw.cn/2025-03/27/content_37930371.htm",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const iconv=require('iconv-lite');",
  "let i=0;",
  "function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
  "  const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  const chunks=[];",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 Chrome/131 Mobile'}},function(res){",
  "    res.on('data',function(d){chunks.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){",
  "      let buf=Buffer.concat(chunks);",
  "      let head=buf.slice(0,3000).toString('latin1');",
  "      let m=/charset=[\\\"']?([\\w-]+)/i.exec(head);",
  "      let enc=m?m[1].toLowerCase():'utf-8';",
  "      let s;",
  "      try{ s = (enc.indexOf('gb')===0)?iconv.decode(buf,'gbk'):buf.toString('utf8'); }catch(e){ s=buf.toString('utf8'); }",
  "      s=s.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      s=s.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34));",
  "      s=s.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+u+' OK '+res.statusCode+' enc='+enc+' len='+s.length);",
  "      console.log(s.substring(0,4000));",
  "      next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message);next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-st2.cjs", content: js });
